name: Visa F-1 (Student, Consular)

phases.name: Document Collection
documents_pt: Página de confirmação do DS-160 (após concluir)
documents_es: Página de confirmación del DS-160 (después de completarlo)
Confirmación de la cita (después de agendarla)
Estados de cuenta bancarios del patrocinador (si aplica)
steps: Define whether a sponsor is needed -- U.S. citizen/permanent resident? relationship? sponsor ID/phone/email/address
Collect school name, English level, financial proof, tuition budget
Confirm current course end date, desired program and campus, course duration and study period, preferred days/time
SEVIS ID verified / tuition amount confirmed
Confirm academic history is consistent with the study plan
Confirm financial capacity covers the full program
Confirm current status (B-2, J-1, etc.) and I-94 expiration
Confirm no overstay, unauthorized employment, or status violation
Define reason for studying in the U.S., reason for choosing this school/program, why now, career connection, future plans in home country

phases.name: Case Preparation
steps: Structure study plan: why this course, why this school, why the U.S., why now, career connection, return plan to home country
Confirm strong academic progression with no inconsistencies
Confirm strong non-immigrant intent with no gaps
Confirm financial evidence is consistent and answers align with DS-160
Practice interview questions with short, objective answers
Draft COS / employer / sponsor / address letters as needed

pricing.notes: No Plus tier. Bundles F-1 primary applicant + F-2 dependents into one package (+$300 per additional dependent).
pricing.source: Real Saes Professional Services contract (Downloads/Contratos), extracted 2026-08-02.

standard_includes: Up to two school options aligned with the client's preferences
Assistance with school application fee payment
Review and validation of supporting documents
standard_excludes: Translations (Portuguese/Spanish to English can be quoted after review)
standard_includes_pt: Orientação sobre documentação de vínculos com o país de origem
Até duas opções de escola alinhadas às preferências do cliente
Assistência com o pagamento da taxa de application da escola
Assistência com o pagamento da taxa SEVIS
Revisão e validação dos documentos de apoio
Criação da conta online do DS-160
Revisão final de 15 minutos / preparação para entrevista
standard_includes_es: Orientación sobre documentación de vínculos con el país de origen
Hasta dos opciones de escuela según las preferencias del cliente
Asistencia con el pago de la tarifa de solicitud escolar
Asistencia con el pago de la tarifa SEVIS
Revisión y validación de los documentos de respaldo
Creación de la cuenta en línea del DS-160
Revisión final de 15 minutos / preparación para la entrevista
standard_excludes_pt: Traduções (português/espanhol para inglês podem ser orçadas após revisão)
standard_excludes_es: Traducciones (portugués/español a inglés pueden cotizarse tras revisión)
